answer: The standard working week at Northwind Labs consists of 38 hours [1]. This is normally spread over a period of five days [1].

Employees must be available during core collaboration hours, which are from 10:00 to 15:00 local time [2]. Outside of these hours, schedules can be arranged freely provided there is team agreement [2].
Overtime worked on a public holiday is compensated as time off in lieu at a rate of 1.5 hours per hour worked [1].
Full-time employees accrue 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [4].

Full-time employees can carry over up to five unused annual leave days into the next calendar year [2]. Any remaining balance exceeding five days expires on 31 March of the following year [2]. Part-time employees receive leave in proportion to their contracted hours [4].
A medical certificate, or doctor's note, is required starting from the third consecutive day of sickness [1].
After completing your probation period, you are allowed to work remotely for up to three days per week [2].

Working from another country is allowed for a maximum of 20 working days per calendar year [1]. This must be registered with HR at least two weeks before departure because of tax and insurance rules [1].

Yes, employees receive a one-off home office allowance of 300 euros, which is paid with the first salary after probation [1]. Additionally, after probation, employees may order an ergonomic chair, an external monitor, and a keyboard and mouse set from the approved catalogue [1].
No, the company will not pay for alcohol, which is never reimbursed [1]. Meal expenses while travelling exclude alcohol entirely [1].
The nightly hotel price limit in London is 250 euros [1].

Each employee receives an annual learning budget of 1,500 euros that can be spent on courses, certifications, conference tickets, and technical books [1]. Unused learning budgets do not carry over [1].

After probation, the notice period for leaving the company is three months, unless the employment contract specifies otherwise [3].
Remaining annual leave should be taken during the notice period [2]. If taking the remaining leave is not possible, unused days are paid out along with the final salary [2].
Business travel expenses must be submitted through the finance portal within 30 days of the trip [1]. Receipts are required for any single expense above 25 euros [1].
Company passwords must contain at least 14 characters [1].
SMS codes are not accepted as a second authentication factor [1].
Administrators are required to use hardware security keys as their second factor [1].
No, passwords are not rotated on a fixed schedule [1]. They only need to be changed immediately if a compromise is suspected [1].
Restricted data, which includes customer personal data, payment information, and cryptographic keys, may only be stored in the approved data platform located in the EU region [1].

Operating system security updates that are marked as critical by IT must be installed within 72 hours of release [2]. Regular operating system security updates must be installed within 14 days of release [2].
Screens must lock automatically after five minutes of inactivity [1].
USB storage devices are blocked by default [1]. However, they can be enabled for a maximum of seven days upon request [1].
Managers review the access rights of their team every quarter [1].
Accounts of employees leaving the company are disabled on their last working day by 18:00 [2].
Security incidents are classified by severity, and Severity 1 represents the most severe level [1]. Severity 1 covers confirmed breaches of Restricted data or ransomware [1].
Production databases are backed up every six hours [1].
The recovery time objective for critical systems is eight hours [1].
Vendor access to internal systems is granted for a maximum of 30 days and is renewable [1].
Employees who click a simulated phishing link are assigned a short follow-up module instead of facing discipline [2].

The CloudBox S2 enclosure is covered by a limited hardware warranty of three years from the purchase date [1]. Supplied drives are covered for two years, and the power adapter is covered for one year [1].
Yes, the drives that are supplied with the device are covered by the warranty for two years [2].

Data stored on the device is never covered, and Northwind Devices does not perform data recovery under the warranty [1]. Customers are strongly advised to keep a second backup of important files, such as by using the built-in cloud backup feature [1].
The warranty does not cover damage caused by liquid [2]. Therefore, spilling coffee on the device is not covered [2].

Products bought directly from the Northwind Devices online store can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund [3]. If you use the advance replacement service during the first year of the warranty, you must return the faulty unit within 14 days in the same packaging [2].
The customer pays return shipping unless the device is faulty [1].
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days after the returned device has been inspected [2].
To start a warranty claim, you must open a return merchandise authorization request in the support portal [1]. Support will then conduct a remote diagnosis with you [1].
For the first year of the warranty, an advance replacement service is available where the replacement is shipped first and you return the faulty unit within 14 days [1].
If you keep the faulty unit after receiving an advance replacement for the first year of the warranty, a fee of 120 euros is charged [1].
Security updates for the CloudBox S2 firmware are provided for at least five years after the product was last sold [2].
Firmware updates install automatically between 02:00 and 05:00 local time [1]. However, this automatic installation will not occur if automatic updates have been switched off in the settings [1].
Installing unofficial firmware does not, by itself, void the hardware warranty [1]. However, it does void the software support [1].
The CloudBox Care plan costs 39 euros per year [1].
No, Northwind Devices cannot read files stored on the device when using remote access through the CloudBox relay service [1].
Northwind Cloud commits to a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.95 percent for Enterprise subscriptions [2].
Downtime is defined as a period of at least five consecutive minutes during which the platform API returns server errors for more than five percent of requests [1].
Business customers receive a 25 percent credit if their uptime drops below 99.0 percent [1].
Credits must be requested through a support ticket within 30 days after the end of the affected month [1].
Service credits are the sole remedy for missed availability and cannot be exchanged for cash [1].
For Business subscriptions, the first response target for Priority 1 issues (which mean the production service is down or unusable for all users) is one hour [1].
Enterprise subscriptions receive a 15-minute first response for Priority 1 issues, which are available around the clock [1].
If a Priority 1 issue is not resolved within four hours, customers may escalate to the duty engineering manager via the escalation number provided in the console [1].
Routine maintenance for Northwind Cloud takes place on Sundays between 01:00 and 05:00 UTC [1].

Routine maintenance is communicated to customers at least seven days in advance via email and the status page [1]. Emergency maintenance for fixing critical security vulnerabilities requires 24 hours' notice [1].
After a subscription ends, customer data remains available for export for 30 days [1]. Following this period, the data is permanently deleted within a further 30 days [1].
No, the uptime commitments in the agreement do not apply to features labelled as preview or beta [1].
Root cause analysis reports for Priority 1 incidents are published within five business days after the incident [1].
